purchase_price.evidence: Trivo listing shows Unit D-107 priced at $58,671 for 40.98m² studio/1-dormitorio. Immediate delivery. Same building as researched sibling D-105. Developer: Andrade Coello Constructora.

monthly_rent.source: Rent comps: FazWaz Barbasquillo 1BR listings; AirROI Manta STR 2026; sibling Nahla D-105 research
monthly_rent.evidence: LTR comps Barbasquillo: $500/mo furnished 90m² 1BR (FazWaz U4105363); $550/mo 70m² suite PZP (U4099505); $600/mo 55m² suite (U4099488); $700/mo 68m² Riva Di Mare (U4133544). Subject is 40.98m² studio (~40-75% of those sizes) in new Airbnb-friendly amenity building. Size-adjusted LTR ~$400-525. STR: Manta AirROI avg $4,104/yr ($342/mo) at 21.7% occ; top-quartile performance needed to beat LTR. Used $475 mid for LTR/mid-STR hybrid assumption.

hoa_monthly.evidence: No published alicuota for Nahla condominiums. Building markets 13 shared amenities (pool, spa, sauna, gym, cinema, coworking, kids room, pet area, 24/7 security, concierge). Nearby Barbasquillo buildings with pool/security advertise ~$78/mo alicuota (Plusvalía); amenity-rich towers elsewhere in Manta run $150-288/mo. Likely $80-150/mo but unverified — must confirm with developer before VIABLE classification.

special_assessments.evidence: New construction with immediate delivery; no HOA history. No evidence of current/upcoming special assessments, but cannot confirm $0 without HOA documentation.

property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador impuesto predial is 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value (typically well below market). Comparable Manta condos often pay $100-400/yr. For ~$58,671 market price, estimated $46-176/yr; used $75. Exact bill depends on Manta municipal rate and cadastral assessment.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is typically included in Ecuador alicuota. Owner contents/liability: ~$140-210/yr base; Manta coastal earthquake risk adds 15-20%. For ~$58,671 condo, estimated $200-400/yr supplemental owner policy; used $250.

management_annual.evidence: Ecuador long-term property management typically 8-15% of rent. At $475/mo, 10% = $570/yr. Self-management possible with local presence (would be $0).

utilities_annual.evidence: For long-term Ecuador rentals, electricity/water/internet are typically tenant-paid. For STR, utilities are usually recovered in nightly rates or included in management fee. Owner direct cost assumed $0 under standard lease; if owner-paid budget $600-1,500/yr.

other_expenses_annual.source: General Ecuador condo / STR ownership research
other_expenses_annual.evidence: Misc reserves: minor repairs, furnishing refresh if STR, internet if owner-provided for STR (~$26-31/mo). Used $250/yr. Amenity fees beyond alicuota unknown.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Nahla marketed for rental income: 'renta temporal (Airbnb-friendly)' and investor language inviting rental returns. No rental prohibition found in public marketing.

str_restrictions.evidence: No building STR ban in marketing; explicitly Airbnb-friendly. AirROI rates Manta STR regulation Low. Ecuador SRI registration/SIP still required for hosts; building bylaws should be confirmed at closing.

notes: Sibling to D-105 (already researched). Key gap remains HOA. Studio ~41m²; LTR more reliable than relying on average Manta STR ($342/mo). Immediate delivery reduces construction risk vs Orongo/Fez pre-sales.
